name: Disconnected
source:
A survival-horror narrative game that places you in the high-stakes role of a 911 dispatcher. Late one night, you receive a panicked call from a woman who wakes up in a bathtub filled with ice, trapped in a crumbling house with no memory of how she got there. As the call unfolds, you realize the horrors she faces go far deeper than just escaping the house. 

[From [url=https://teharra-rose.itch.io/disconnected]Itch.io[/url]]
